mapper.select: select dept_id,parent_id,dept_name,status,del_flag from sys_dept where status='0' and del_flag='0' order by order_num,dept_id
select role_id,role_name,status,del_flag from sys_role where status='0' and del_flag='0' order by role_sort,role_id

select u.user_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.dept_id, d.dept_name from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id=u.dept_id where u.status='0' and u.del_flag='0'
and u.user_id in #{id} and 1=0 and (u.user_name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or u.nick_name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%'))
and u.user_id in #{id}
and exists (select 1 from sys_dept selected where selected.del_flag='0' and selected.dept_id in #{id} and (u.dept_id=selected.dept_id or find_in_set(selected.dept_id,d.ancestors)))
and exists (select 1 from sys_user_role ur join sys_role r on r.role_id=ur.role_id where ur.user_id=u.user_id and r.status='0' and r.del_flag='0' and ur.role_id in #{id})
order by u.user_id
